title: Old Fashioned Crunchy British Beetroot Full English Breakfast
description: A traditional British breakfast dish featuring crunchy beetroot, cured meats, and a variety of savory ingredients, all cooked to perfection in a cazuela. This hearty meal is sure to satisfy any appetite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cazuela, cook the diced beetroot in a little oil over medium heat until crunchy.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the cazuela and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the back bacon and black pudding to the cazuela and cook until the bacon is crispy.
Add the sausages to the cazuela and cook until browned on all sides.
Crack the eggs into the cazuela and scramble them until cooked through.
Add the baked beans to the cazuela and stir to combine.
Toast the bread until lightly browned.
Serve the mixture in the cazuela with the toast on the side.
